definitions: A living organism of the kind exemplified by trees, shrubs, herbs, grasses, ferns, and mosses, typically growing in a permanent site, absorbing water and inorganic substances through its roots, and synthesizing nutrients in its leaves by photosynthesis using the energy of sunlight.
A place where an industrial or manufacturing process takes place.
The equipment and machinery, including buildings, used in an industrial or manufacturing process.
A person placed in a group as a spy or informer.
A trick or a joke intended to deceive someone.
examples: The car manufacturing plant employs thousands.
The company invested in new plant.
He was a plant from the rival company.
It was all a plant to get him to confess.
